name: bergner-skills
description: Herman Bergner's public marketplace of reusable Claude Code agent skills.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: The house authoring formats, bundled as one domain plugin — handing a discrete task to a Claude Code agent (claude-code-handover) and authoring well-formed tasks in the Bergner todo MCP (authoring-todo-tasks) — plus /authoring:handover and /authoring:todo-task commands to invoke them on demand.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Reviews a GitHub PR the way the platform expects — diff-focused, only findings it is ≥80 confident in, acceptance-criteria + scope + secrets + security first-class, the summary commented back on the todo review task. Read-only; never approves, never merges.
